description: Phase 5 principal experiment: three independently generated operating points; frozen controllers only
generator: configs/phase2.json 'generator' section, unchanged except process_count fixed to n_processes

statistics.estimand: per operating point: mean over workloads of log(T_method / T_comparator), T = mean job turnaround of the workload; reported as exp(.)-1
statistics.also_reported: change in aggregate mean turnaround = mean(T_method)/mean(T_comparator) - 1, with paired bootstrap CI
statistics.test: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test of the mean log ratio
statistics.multiplicity: Holm within the primary family (6) and, separately, within the secondary family (9); identical decision vectors merged first
statistics.decision_rule: statistically supported iff Holm p < alpha and 95% CI upper bound < 0; practically meaningful iff supported and CI upper bound <= -sesoi; practically negligible iff the whole 95% CI lies within (-sesoi, +sesoi)
statistics.pooled: equal-weight average of the three per-operating-point means; bootstrap stratified by operating point; descriptive, not in either family
